search_text: published ZDI-14-111 ZDI-CAN-2019 Oracle Data Quality LoaderWizard ActiveX Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2014-04-21 CVE-2014-2407 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-2407 6.8 ['Oracle'] ['Data Quality'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Oracle Data Quality. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the TSS12.LoaderWizard.lwctrl ActiveX control. The issue lies in the failure to properly initialize values leading to a use-after-free condition. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the current process. Oracle has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Oracle Data Quality LoaderWizard ActiveX Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Oracle Data Quality. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the TSS12.LoaderWizard.lwctrl ActiveX control. The issue lies in the failure to properly initialize values leading to a use-after-free condition. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the current process.
